needs-triage.description: Awaiting a maintainer assessment; not implementation approval.

triage/needs-information.description: Waiting for the specific information or decision requested in the issue.

triage/accepted.description: A trusted maintainer accepted the current scope for implementation.

awaiting-release.description: The accepted fix is merged; delivery to the affected image is still pending.

needs-verification.description: Verified delivery evidence is recorded; the reporter should test the fix.

needs-kind.description: A maintainer must classify this issue; the intake source did not establish its kind.

kind/bug.description: Something is broken or behaves incorrectly.

kind/task.description: An explicit maintenance task or standing tracking issue.

human-only.description: Human interaction only: no machine analysis or agent implementation.

needs-human.description: Human input is required before Hive may start new implementation work.

tracking.description: Standing dashboard or portfolio tracker, not an implementation task.
